executive_summary: 9 findings across 3 hosts (6 critical, 3 high by CVSS band); 3 are listed in the CISA KEV catalog. Findings are ranked by fuzzy priority using each asset's simulated exposure and criticality. Top 3 by priority: CVE-2021-41773 on Public website (Apache httpd) (172.30.0.12:80, priority 88.3 urgent); CVE-2021-42013 on Public website (Apache httpd) (172.30.0.12:80, priority 88.3 urgent); CVE-2022-22965 on Customer portal (Spring WebMVC, Java) (172.30.0.18:8080, priority 88.3 urgent). Scenario: Simulated ACME Retail environment: public website, online shop, customer portal and public API are internet-facing; the corporate CMS, a partner portal and a staging app sit in the DMZ; CI, logging, search and file sharing are internal only. In reality all containers are isolated on a local Docker network without internet access.

findings.title: Apache httpd 2.4.49 path traversal and information disclosure
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent

findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later, where path normalization flaws are resolved. Ensure path normalization checks properly handle URL-encoded sequences and traversal patterns. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory, CWE-26 Path Traversal: '/dir/../filename').

findings.title: Apache httpd 2.4.49 path traversal and remote code execution
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent

findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later to fully address the incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773. Restrict access to directory handlers and verify that Require all denied or equivalent access controls are enforced on sensitive document roots. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory).

findings.evidence: host: lab-host-18, port: 8080, service: Spring WebMVC, version: 5.3.17
findings.label: urgent

findings.remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to version 5.3.18+, 5.2.20+, or later. Apply workarounds such as upgrading Tomcat if immediate patching is not possible. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-94 Improper Control of Generation of Code, https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/94.html)

findings.title: Apache httpd 2.4.49 buffer overflow in mod_lua
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent

findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.52 or later to mitigate the mod_lua multipart parser buffer overflow. Disable mod_lua if Lua scripts are not actively required by the web application. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-787 Out-of-bounds Write).
